I’ll inspect both streaming adapters, apply the Python style guidance, and add focused tests for tool-call indices across chunks.
The working tree already has staged regression tests for parallel calls in both providers. I’ll preserve those and add coverage for LiteLLM’s missing-index fallback. Gemini’s counter will be local to each stream and tracked per candidate so separate choices stay independent.
Implemented the indexing fix:

- Gemini numbers tool calls consecutively across chunks, separately per candidate.
- LiteLLM preserves supplied indices, falling back to chunk position only when absent or `None`.
- Added fallback tests and preserved existing staged regressions.

All 129 tests in both provider files passed, but pytest exited with a sandbox permission error during its final process-reporting hook. No dependencies were installed.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("split_across_chunks", [False, True])
+async def test_gemini_chat_stream_parallel_tool_calls_get_distinct_indices(split_across_chunks):
+    call_a = {"functionCall": {"name": "get_weather", "args": {"city": "Baku"}}}
+    call_b = {"functionCall": {"name": "get_time", "args": {"tz": "UTC"}}}
+    part_groups = [[call_a], [call_b]] if split_across_chunks else [[call_a, call_b]]
+    resp = [
+        line
+        for parts in part_groups
+        for line in (
+            b"data: "
+            + json.dumps({"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": parts}}]}).encode()

+            b"\n",

+    ] + [b"data: [DONE]\n"]
+    mock_client = mock_http_client(MockAsyncStreamingResponse(resp))
+    provider = GeminiProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))

         assert call_kwargs["stream_options"]["include_usage"] is True
 
 
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_chat_stream_keeps_parallel_tool_call_indices():
+    def make_chunk(*tool_calls):
+        chunk = mock.MagicMock()
+        chunk.id = "chunk"
+        chunk.object = "chat.completion.chunk"
+        chunk.created = 1234567890
+        chunk.model = "gpt-4o"
+        chunk.usage = None
+        choice = mock.MagicMock()
+        choice.index = 0
+        choice.finish_reason = None
+        choice.delta = mock.MagicMock(spec=["role", "content", "tool_calls"])
+        choice.delta.role = None
+        choice.delta.content = None
+        choice.delta.tool_calls = [
+            mock.MagicMock(index=i, id=id_, type="function", function=mock.MagicMock())
+            for i, id_, _, _ in tool_calls
+        ]
+        for tc, (_, _, name, args) in zip(choice.delta.tool_calls, tool_calls):
+            tc.function.name = name
+            tc.function.arguments = args
+        chunk.choices = [choice]
+        return chunk
+
+    async def mock_stream():
+        yield make_chunk((0, "call_a", "get_weather", ""))
+        yield make_chunk((1, "call_b", "get_time", ""))
+        # A later chunk carries arguments for call 1 only.
+        yield make_chunk((1, None, None, '{"tz": "UTC"}'))
+        yield make_chunk((0, None, None, '{"city": "Baku"}'))
+
+    with mock.patch("litellm.acompletion", return_value=mock_stream()) as mock_acompletion:
+        provider = LiteLLMProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()), enable_tracing=True)
+        payload = {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}], "stream": True}
+        chunks = [c async for c in provider.chat_stream(chat.RequestPayload(**payload))]
+
+    mock_acompletion.assert_called_once()
+    calls = [tc for c in chunks for tc in c.choices[0].delta.tool_calls]
+    assert [tc.index for tc in calls] == [0, 1, 1, 0]
+    args = {}
+    for tc in calls:
+        args[tc.index] = args.get(tc.index, "") + (tc.function.arguments or "")
+    assert args == {0: '{"city": "Baku"}', 1: '{"tz": "UTC"}'}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("indices", [[None, None], ["missing", "missing"], [1, 0]])
+async def test_chat_stream_tool_call_index_fallback(indices):
+    tool_calls = []
+    for index in indices:
+        tc = mock.MagicMock(id=None, type="function")
+        tc.function.name = "get_weather"
+        tc.function.arguments = "{}"
+        if index == "missing":
+            del tc.index
+        else:
+            tc.index = index
+        tool_calls.append(tc)
+
+    async def mock_stream():
+        yield mock.MagicMock(
+            id="chunk",
+            object="chat.completion.chunk",
+            created=1234567890,
+            model="gpt-4o",
+            usage=None,
+            choices=[
+                mock.MagicMock(
+                    index=0,
+                    finish_reason=None,
+                    delta=mock.MagicMock(role=None, content=None, tool_calls=tool_calls),
+                )
+            ],
+        )
+
+    provider = LiteLLMProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+    payload = chat.RequestPayload(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}])
+    with mock.patch("litellm.acompletion", return_value=mock_stream()) as mock_acompletion:
+        chunks = [chunk async for chunk in provider.chat_stream(payload)]
+
+    mock_acompletion.assert_called_once()
+    expected = [1, 0] if indices == [1, 0] else [0, 1]
+    assert [tc.index for tc in chunks[0].choices[0].delta.tool_calls] == expected
+
